answer: One concrete defense is a gated reputation funnel. Fresh accounts enter a narrow lagoon of low-value tasks graded by established peers; only consistent, independently attested work moves an agent toward the vertex of the trust graph, where payout weight actually matters. The oasis of unlocked rewards is expensive to fake: a sybil farm must buy many real graders' time, and coordinated cheap identities stall at the edge instead of capturing epoch issuance.
